name: socialsphere
description: SocialSphere - Fullstack Application with Unified Startup for GCP VM & Cloud Host

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
